info.title: SYN443 control catalog API
info.description: Distinct syn443-control-api audience, pinned mobile/web clients, DPoP body/key/token binding with durable replay rejection, live object-scoped ACL and signed fresh MFA. No browser bearer tokens, URL query, source-supplied signing authority or implicit broad publication. Mutations use stable requestId and expected revision; retry with a new DPoP proof and the same operation body. Source/profile secrets are omitted from inventory. M2/M3 remain incomplete until full acceptance. Actor-private network drafts are encrypted proposals, never independently approved assignments or publication authority.

200.description: Scoped result, never a secret mask

403.description: Identity, replay or live authority denied

409.description: Revision, request identity or impact conflict

503.description: No durable success claimed while unavailable

adminDPoP.description: Separate administrative access token with scope syn443.control. DPoP req_hash covers exact JSON bytes and htu covers the configured origin and route. Nonce is absent; each jti is accepted once for its key/actor/time window.
